NO FRAMEWORK REQUIRED

A small component.
A simple conversation.

Load the module, place the custom element, and send your app’s events. Use a direct mood override when you need explicit control.

Read the integration guide ↗
HTML + JavaScript
<script type="module" src="./src/lekuvo-mascot.js"></script>

<lekuvo-mascot id="buddy" mood="lazy"
  size="96" motion="auto"></lekuvo-mascot>

<script type="module">
  await customElements.whenDefined('lekuvo-mascot');
  const buddy = document.querySelector('#buddy');

  buddy.trigger('media:play');
  buddy.trigger('audio:listening-start');
  buddy.trigger('audio:listening-end');

  // Explicitly choose a mood and clear event states.
  buddy.setMood('wave');
</script>
